content_sections.heading: About District Health Society Tirupathur
content_sections.text: District Health Society, Tirupathur District works from the District Health Office at Chairman Lakshmanan Street, Tirupathur, Tamil Nadu. In this notice it fills Staff Nurse posts on contract basis / purely temporary in nature in Government Hospital CEmONC centres, including SNCU and PICU.

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Tirupathur Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The application window is open as of 21 November 2026. The notice does not print an application start date.

rows.event: Last date for applications to reach the District Health Office

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Tirupathur Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists 54 vacancies in the district, marked "Subject to Change". The notice does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Tirupathur Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Other conditions printed in the notice: Valid Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council. Working knowledge of Tamil is mandatory, evidenced through SSLC/HSC mark sheet. Applications submitted for the similar post notified earlier will not be considered for these vacancies. Fresh applications must be submitted. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.qualification_required: G.N.M. / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the university approved under state norms.

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Tirupathur Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the Staff Nurse post is up to 50 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Health Society Tirupathur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the https://tirupathur.nic.in website. The Terms of Reference can be downloaded from the same website. Fill in the application form. Attach self-attested photocopies of the applicable documents. Send the application to: The District Health Officer / Executive Secretary, District Health Office, District Health Society, Chairman Lakshmanan Street, Near Municipal office, Tirupathur (Tk.) & Tirupathur (Dt.), PIN CODE – 635601. Make sure the application reaches the address on or before 04.12.2026, 5.00 P.M. The notice does not state how the application is to be delivered (post or by hand).

content_sections.heading: Documents Named in the Notice
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of the applicable documents. SSLC/HSC mark sheet, as evidence of working knowledge of Tamil.

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Tirupathur Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after 04.12.2026, 5.00 P.M. will not be considered. Applications submitted for the similar post notified earlier will not be considered; fresh applications must be submitted. The posts are on contract basis / purely temporary in nature. The number of vacancies is subject to change.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in District Health Society Tirupathur?
faq.answer: The notice lists 54 vacancies for Contract / Temporary Staff Nurse in the district, and the number is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Health Office, Tirupathur on or before 04.12.2026, 5.00 P.M. Applications received after that time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: G.N.M. / B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government approved Private Nursing College, recognised by the university approved under state norms, plus valid registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is knowledge of Tamil required?
faq.answer: Yes, working knowledge of Tamil is mandatory, and it must be evidenced through the SSLC/HSC mark sheet.

faq.question: Q6. How and where do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the application form from https://tirupathur.nic.in, fill it in, attach self-attested photocopies of the applicable documents and send it to the District Health Officer / Executive Secretary, District Health Office, Chairman Lakshmanan Street, Tirupathur, PIN 635601.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on contract basis / purely temporary in nature.

faq.question: Q8. Will earlier applications for a similar post be considered?
faq.answer: No, applications submitted for the similar post notified earlier will not be considered, and fresh applications must be submitted for these vacancies.
